summary: Bitmine Immersion Technologies filed an 8-K on September 4, 2026, disclosing that its subsidiary BMNR Subsidiary One terminated a Management Services Agreement with Ethereum Tower LLC effective close of business September 3, 2026. The MSA, originally dated March 24, 2026, granted Ethereum Tower revenue participation from Ethereum staking and featured a ten-year term. Both parties waived the 180-day termination notice. No material early termination penalties were incurred. Simultaneously, the Company entered a new services agreement with American Validator LLC, an Ethereum Tower affiliate, effective September 4, 2026, for advisory staking services at a simplified 1.50% fee on staking rewards. Board recommendation and advisors were not named. The structural shift simplifies compensation but introduces affiliate-service concentration risk; watch for disclosure of any accrued payments or related-party exposure.
